<script>

files.name: lib/TheSpot.svelte
files.contents:
A quiet corner café with window tables and a small back room. Easy to talk, easy to linger.

14 Quillfeather Lane · 18 min walk Open until 6:00 PM on Saturdays

{#snippet actions()} (held = true)} /> ask('Walking directions from 27 Pellory Street to Wrenhollow Coffee, 14 Quillfeather Lane, 18 minutes', 'Directions')} /> {/snippet}

files.name: lib/Options.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
  import { Section, Action, Table, ask } from 'design';
  import MagnifyingGlass from 'phosphor-svelte/lib/MagnifyingGlass';

  const columns = ['Café', 'Walk', 'Noise', 'Flat white'];
  const rows = [
    ['Wrenhollow Coffee', '18 min', 'Quiet', '$4.50'],
    ['Bramblecup', '11 min', 'Busy', '$4.25'],
    ['Larkspire Roasters', '24 min', 'Calm', '$5.00']
  ];
</script>

<Section title="Other cafés" kicker="If Wrenhollow is full">
  <Table {columns} {rows} pick={0} />
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Action
      label="More nearby"
      icon={MagnifyingGlass}
      onclick={() => ask('More quiet cafés within a 20-minute walk of 27 Pellory Street, open Saturday afternoon', 'More nearby')}
    />
  {/snippet}
</Section>

files.name: lib/GettingThere.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
  import { Section, Action, List, ListRow } from 'design';
  import Clock from 'phosphor-svelte/lib/Clock';

  let reminder = $state(false);
</script>

<Section title="Getting there" kicker="On foot · 18 minutes">
  <List>
    <ListRow index={1} label="Leave home" sub="27 Pellory Street" trailing="2:38 PM" current />
    <ListRow index={2} label="Through Calloway Gardens" sub="Shaded path, about halfway" trailing="2:47 PM" />
    <ListRow index={3} label="Arrive at Wrenhollow" sub="14 Quillfeather Lane" trailing="2:56 PM" />
    <ListRow index={4} label="Meet Mara" sub="Window table" trailing="3:00 PM" />
  </List>
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Action
      label={reminder ? 'Reminder set' : 'Remind me to leave'}
      sublabel={reminder ? 'Saturday, 2:30 PM' : 'Alert at 2:30 PM'}
      icon={Clock}
      primary
      disabled={reminder}
      onclick={() => (reminder = true)}
    />
  {/snippet}
</Section>

files.name: lib/TellMara.svelte
files.contents:
Hi Mara, still on for tomorrow at 3? Wrenhollow Coffee on Quillfeather Lane. I'll grab a window table.
